Thanks — reviewing. A few clarifications from comp/HR side:

- The comp-band-guidelines_Q3_2026.pdf shows L5 base band in SF as $140k–$175k (midpoint $157.5k). So $170k is inside but toward top decile.
- Equity: internal mapping = 1 RSU unit in the offer draft = 1 Redwood common share equivalent; 6,000 is therefore a true 6k unit grant. That said, our typical L5 grant has risen in the last year; 5k is now a reasonable top-of-band number.
- Bonus: 15% is standard.
- Sign-on: $15k is above our typical $10k for L5 but we can approve up to $20k for strategic hires under manager + director sign-off.

Given the competing offer signal and the candidate's track record (3 years at an ML startup + prior research publications), my rec is: approve base $170k, equity reduce to 5,250 RSUs, keep sign-on at $15k. We can attach a 12-month cliff with standard 4-year vesting. If Markus wants to go all the way to 6k we should table an additional justification (critical hire/special skill).

I'll flag payroll/legal to confirm any tax formatting for split sign-on.

-Marissa
